# Third-party marks (unmodified)

Logos of other companies' products, kept exactly as their owners publish them, for
the "works with" list on /mcp. They are their owners' trademarks and are not covered
by this repository's licence. Where each came from and what its owner allows is in
`docs/design/BRAND_LOGOS.md` and `command-center/lib/dev/brand-logos.ts`. Do not edit
these files; `tools/brand/build_brand_logos.mjs` turns them into the inline SVG the page uses.
